We currently have approximately 150 jewellery SKUs, and we need 6–7 unique, professional images for each SKU, resulting in approximately 900–1,050 final images.
The images will be used for our website, Shopify store, WhatsApp Catalogue, Instagram, Facebook, Google Shopping and international/global marketing campaigns.

The jewellery item must NOT be changed, redesigned, replaced or modified.

Shape
Design
Stones
Pattern
Colour
Finish
Size/proportions
Number and position of stones
Chains, hooks, clasps and other details

Hero / Main Catalogue Image
Premium luxury presentation suitable for Shopify/product listing.
High-Fashion Model Image
Jewellery worn by a sophisticated fashion model with a premium editorial aesthetic.
Close-Up / Macro Detail
Detailed close-up showing stones, texture, finish and craftsmanship.
Lifestyle / UGC Image
Natural-looking premium UGC-style image suitable for social media advertising.
Editorial / Luxury Fashion Image
High-end fashion campaign style with sophisticated styling.
Different Model / Styling Variation
Another realistic model, pose, outfit or composition while keeping the jewellery unchanged.
Creative Premium Product Shot
Artistic luxury composition suitable for social media, advertisements or campaign creatives.

Visual Style
The overall catalogue should communicate:
Premium • Elegant • Modern • High Fashion • Luxury • Sophisticated • Global
The visual direction should be suitable for an international audience and comparable to premium fashion-jewellery/e-commerce brands.
We want to avoid:
Cheap-looking AI imagery
Overly artificial models
Unrealistic skin
Distorted jewellery
Excessive jewellery enlargement
Fake-looking gemstones
Inconsistent product colours
Generic stock-photo appearance
Heavy filters
Overly complicated backgrounds
Product Categories
Our catalogue may include:
Earrings
Necklaces
Bracelets
Other fashion jewellery
The freelancer should be able to adapt the photography style according to the product.
Consistency Across the Catalogue
This is extremely important.
All images belonging to the same SKU should maintain:
Exact same jewellery
Consistent product proportions
Consistent colour and finish
Realistic placement on the model
Premium skin/hair rendering
Consistent luxury brand aesthetic
The complete catalogue should look like it was created by one professional global jewellery photography team, rather than hundreds of unrelated AI images.
Deliverables
Approximately:
150 SKUs × 6–7 images = 900–1,050 final images
Preferred output:
High-resolution JPG/PNG
E-commerce-ready resolution
4:5 or 1:1 where appropriate for product/catalogue images
9:16 where specifically required for social-media creatives
Clean file naming according to SKU
Organised folders by SKU
No visible AI artefacts or watermarks
Ideal Freelancer
We are looking for someone with proven experience in:
AI jewellery/product photography
AI UGC image generation
Fashion model generation
Jewellery retouching
E-commerce catalogue photography
Luxury/fashion visual design
Product consistency across multiple AI-generated images
Experience with jewellery is strongly preferred.
Before Awarding the Project
Please provide:
5–10 examples of your previous jewellery/product AI work
Examples showing the same product used across multiple images
Your preferred AI tools/workflow
Confirmation that you can maintain exact product consistency
Your price for 150 SKUs / approximately 900–1,050 images
Estimated turnaround time
Whether revisions are included
We may initially select 2–3 SKUs as a paid trial before assigning the complete catalogue.
Quality is more important than simply generating a large number of images.
Our goal is to build a premium, globally marketable jewellery catalogue for Queziva, so consistency, realism and product accuracy are the highest priorities.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that focuses on creating systems capable of performing tasks that normally require human intelligence. It includes areas like machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and robotics.

• Transportation – self-driving cars, traffic control

• Automates repetitive tasks
